reviews.classification: historical delivery / superseded disposition / missing native proof / authority routing
reviews.disposition:
Historical natural-entry delivery and later authority, reconciled under AD36/AD41/AD42/AD43. Read all interim/final paragraphs: both school and trade use plain-start deliberate Beginning preview/cancel/confirm, not a hidden structured-candidate query. Supply week is authored preceding background, not seven days simulated or a new guardian actor. Cargo/Frontier currency conservation differs from declared local means; no exchange or cross-world reward is implied. D7 definitions/command/save compatibility stays separate from E3's transient choice/controller presentation.

Final confirmation-above-detail and stale-confirm refusal supersede the earlier below-fold capture. Sixteen captures and actual clipping/viewport checks retain their two-size/two-font/two-life scope; old-master archive reconstruction, pre-entry downloaded export, D7 browser fixture import and golden in-flight jobs test different compatibility cases. The full command2882/2886 with four localhost EPERM errors remains a non-green invocation; targeted9/9 outside the socket restriction is environmental recovery, not a second full-suite pass. Final13/13 focused checks overlap. No current build or save identity follows from historical hashes.

The original human-only acceptance wording is historical: AD42 makes human play/feel optional review, not a required technical blocker. This checkpoint's branch-ready/no-master/push state is also earlier than the fully read B485 master checkpoint's later integration/publication chronology; those later actions retain their own authority/identities. Source-ready HP-X4 was later integrated as recorded there, so this early list of X4 proposals does not override its subsequent bounded delivery. Wider terms/holidays/careers and other X horizons remain separate. Old branch/subagent/port/escalation instructions are not present execution or process authority. Full content was reviewed without opening old saves, fixtures, screenshots, app or source today.
reviews.evidence: Fresh complete content read of all four files, including late final gates, applied-amendment paragraph, fixture startup correction and all R1 hashes/checks. No linked source/private/runtime bodies read by implication.
reviews.reopen: Use the current original owner and named producer/consumer or verification gap; historical shell/worker instructions are not present authority.

reviews.classification: historical delivery / superseded disposition / missing native proof / authority routing
reviews.disposition:
Mixed proposal/application chronology under AD32/AD36/AD43. The Subsequent integration paragraph supersedes the lower WFA1 coordinator-work-not-performed and WFA2 proposed-only dispositions for their stated document scope: qualified LR2-L1–L3/H1–H3 rows went to existing plans and operation/occurrence/disclosure distinctions went to guide10. WFA3 was applied as a source-exposure procedure, not implemented retrieval-tool or host enforcement. Keep original draft sections as history instead of deleting their useful worked cases. The plan's earlier dependency-ready characterization was retired because JR1 source/scene/carrier gaps remained, not because delivery order changed.

The HP worked row separates actual act, detector signal, attributed actor claim and real authority consequence. Detection does not identify a caster or impose sanction automatically; generic light/sound is not a source-qualified detector. Occurrence era differs from later explanation/observer knowledge, and an expert statement remains T rather than depicted-result S. LOTM perceptibility, control acquisition and positional operation must keep their own conditions rather than inheriting HP or one shared range. Old noticed facts cannot be migrated into proven guilt, retrospective conviction or earlier private knowledge.

The6443 versus6000 exposure is a real recorded443-word overrun. Stopping reading/preserving windows did not undo it; unsuccessful/irrelevant/unused exposed windows still count, while retaining already read text is not a second reading. Before-output count examples are proposed operational checks, not passing tool fixtures. The later application does not increase the source cap or authorize acquisition, broad rereads, runtime or worker dispatch now. Six clusters do not satisfy WA48's broader schema-design sample; WA51–WA53 retain proposed status. This full-file review reads no private primary windows, world-plan/guide/playbook body or current tool implementation. It preserves specific missing producers without turning them into in-world impossibilities or a universal surveillance/consent engine.

reviews.classification: historical delivery / superseded disposition / missing native proof / authority routing
reviews.disposition:
Historical synthetic fixture and startup correction under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve the level9 threshold-minus-one and level10 deliberately-locked saved availability cases: native loading/earning reconstructs a milestone rather than seeding the finished ingot/brace/kits. Supplied XP, stock, access, mastery/energy and facility setup are generated test history, not a naturally played campaign or balance acceptance. The iron-smelt attempt, failed roll possibility, earned milestone and later actual equipped quote are different consumers. Finite drive reserve and unrelated focus quote remain useful controlled comparisons.

YAIR-UTF8-1 text exports are the literal Import payloads; readable JSON companions are not interchangeable. Native create_save/encode/import/load with fresh definitions and in-memory storage establishes model serialization/reconstruction, not browser file picker, iframe, Web Locks, actual storage or visible UI. The initial stubbed biography missed real PLAY startup failure despite travel advancing time. Later default biography regeneration and diagnostic using actual run/extracted biography prove the stated Node startup/tick/reload gates; old imported fixtures remain incomplete until re-importing repaired bytes. Do not treat more Node assertions as the missing native browser loop.

The final browser gate in this README is evidence-limited: fixtures cannot establish visible controls, browser persistence or natural acquisition. Human review is optional AD42 review rather than a mandatory owner/chat dependency. Old A1/Claude naming and generation/diagnostic commands are historical routes, not instructions executed today. No actual fixture file, generated hero, timer, browser or personal-save content was inspected/replayed by this full README review. Retain initial failures and corrected gate receipts without deleting useful preparations or inventing a gameplay source change.

reviews.classification: historical delivery / superseded disposition / missing native proof / authority routing
reviews.disposition:
Historical owner/routing repair, not runtime delivery, under AD32/AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve RFX1–RFX6/RFX8, G1/G2 and WDI44 distinctions: RPT13–14's standing date differs from earlier defaults; making-path globs correct automatic discovery rather than newly creating the standing making policy. Proposed UIV5 remains proposed. Consolidated design/rune pointers needed verification rather than another donor specification. Reversible authorized tuning does not need an extra taste-approval blocker, but agent proof does not accept an unaccepted feature.

SAVES' decided unknown-ID drop/log default, ordinary inventory warn/skip branch, other loader paths and malformed/future envelopes are different cases. A throw from a preflight stub does not establish actual unknown-item literal-import behavior. G1 real-loader cross-owner cases and G2 selected pack-save wiring remain conditional missing proof; this doc reconciliation does not run them. Current single-target admission does not demonstrate cross-target bleed: add target separation when the actual parameter admission expands, without presenting WDI44's future risk as a reproduced current bug.

Report-voice source-shape/global-name checks are not actual world-start/work-place/control evidence. The historical inspection hashes bind source/read scope at that time, not current runtime compliance. The17 warnings and40 doc diagnostics are original shared-tree results, neither today's gate nor reason to rewrite concurrent owners. Adding default framing removed the original lane's UR2 lint finding without changing authority. This full receipt read does not freshly inspect the five owner bodies, code, golden paths or runtime tests; no renewed rule behavior/save/browser proof, code acceptance or new rule family follows. Retain actual routing, loader and target-consumer reopen conditions in their current owners.
